content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhubaneswar (AIIMS Bhubaneswar) for an ICMR funded project based in Odisha.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Project Research Scientist -1 (Medical) and Project Technical Support-II, offering a total of 3 vacancies across these designations.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for various project-based roles in this recruitment notification released by AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Project Research Scientist-1?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Project Research Scientist -1 (Medical) post must hold an MBBS/BVSc/BDS degree along with a minimum of one year of residency or related work experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for Project Technical Support-II?
faq.answer: Candidates need a 12th pass in Science with a Diploma in MLT/DMLT or a three-year graduate degree in a relevant field, coupled with the requisite years of professional experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is set at 35 years for the Project Research Scientist -1 (Medical) post and 30 years for the Project Technical Support-II post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range offered?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary ranging between Rs. 20,000 to Rs. 67,000 per month, plus an additional 20% HRA as per project guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications via email is 30 September 2026. Interested candidates must apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates need to send their duly filled application form and documents to [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the screening of applications, shortlisting of eligible candidates, followed by a test or interview conducted by AIIMS Bhubaneswar.
